warning_text.const: Emerging and unverified. SmithGuard has not independently confirmed this warning and is awaiting authoritative or non-social confirmation. Use it to investigate, not as proof or authorization for a disruptive action.

x-smithguard-handling.logging: event ID, incident ID, type, actor class, and revision only
x-smithguard-handling.export: public events omit private actor identity and restricted evidence

version_range_evaluation.description: How version ranges are decided: ecosystem_rules orders versions with the registry's own rules; digest_only matches immutable digests; not_supported leaves ranges undecided.

x-smithguard-handling.logging: action ID, type, risk level, and approval class only
x-smithguard-handling.export: typed plan without credentials, commands, or private paths

x-smithguard-handling.logging: request ID and exact public coordinate only
x-smithguard-handling.export: request may contain only a public artifact coordinate

PublicOriginContext.description: Upstream symbol and platform assertions with dated source provenance; application reachability is not assessed and this context never changes package-version applicability.

applies_to_version.description: Whether this source record's own package ranges include the requested version; other reports never supply its applicability.

fixed_versions.description: Fix candidates explicitly reported by this source for the package, across release branches. Assess the chosen exact target version; other sources may disagree.

applies_to_version.description: Whether this incident's affected versions include the requested version, compared with the ecosystem's own version rules; null when the ranges cannot decide. npm ranges deliberately include prereleases that fall inside the range (node-semver would skip them), so a prerelease can read as affected.

fixed_versions.description: Source-reported fix candidates across release branches and sources (explicit patched versions, fix events and legacy exclusive upper bounds), lowest first. This union is not a safe-upgrade guarantee: sources can disagree; assess the chosen exact target version and inspect each source report.

aliases.description: Public advisory identifiers for this incident, such as GHSA, CVE and MAL IDs.

upstream_urls.description: The upstream advisory records behind this incident.

freshness_state.description: fresh or complete means current; anything else means recent reports may be missing.

AssessmentSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the whole response without this field: keys sorted, no whitespace, non-ASCII escaped as \uXXXX. Verify with the key at /v1/public-keys/{public_key_id}.json.

PublicArtifactAssessmentShortRequest.title: Short public artifact assessment request
PublicArtifactAssessmentShortRequest.description: The simple request form: an ecosystem, a package name and an exact version (or an immutable digest). The registry host defaults to the ecosystem's public registry and is required only for container images.

x-smithguard-handling.logging: assessment ID, public coordinate, result, feed revision, and counts
x-smithguard-handling.export: public evidence and explicit unknowns

cve_context.description: Exact CVE context for listed incident aliases. Supplemental EPSS and KEV context never changes the assessment result; missing values are unknown, and failed or stale sources retain their dated values with that state.

not_applicable_incident_count.description: Matching-package incidents left out because their affected versions exclude the requested version.

incidents_truncated.description: True when more applicable incidents exist than the 100 listed.

source_freshness.description: Freshness of each source that covers this ecosystem.

signature.description: Present on every public API answer; null only in unsigned local use.
